title: ¿Cómo se dice?

full_script: [happy] Diez frases muy útiles. Intenta decirlas en inglés antes de que aparezcan. I have a reservation. What time is breakfast? What's the wifi password? The room is really cold. Could I get a wake-up call at seven? The shower doesn't work. Can I leave my bag here? Could you call me a taxi? What time is checkout? I'd like to stay one more night. [curious] ¿Cuál no conocías? Cuéntamelo abajo.
